evidence.watermark: full FileBlade SVG artwork, bottom-right, 32px visible padding
evidence.review: Reviewed captured frames at 0.8 and 4.8 seconds against the scenario and its real postcondition. The visible action/result agrees with the bounded proof; wallpaper, full SVG branding and narrow blade remain visible.

features.limitations: The demonstration changes only the capture profile's keymap.
